summary: System card for GPT-Rosalind-5.5, a life-sciences model incrementally trained from GPT-5.5 and deployed via trusted access to vetted organizations. Reports beneficial biology capability evals and Preparedness bio/chem evals, and describes a safeguards approach relying on trusted access, model-level boundaries and monitoring rather than real-time blocking monitors.

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: High (below Critical) in Biological and Chemical; cyber at or below GPT-5.5; AI Self-Improvement relies on GPT-5.5 assessment (below High)
framework.quote: Under our Preparedness Framework, the Preparedness evaluations in the Biological and Chemical domain met our threshold for High capability while falling below the threshold for Critical.

evals: DNA sequence design for TF binding (vs Ledidi, Nucleobench)
cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Meets or exceeds GPT-5.5 on all but one bio eval; treated as High but below Critical; protein-binding and DNA design far below proposed concern thresholds.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: As we did for GPT-5.5, we are treating this launch as High capability in the Biological and Chemical domain.

cyber.finding: Cyber capabilities stated to be at or below GPT-5.5; inherits GPT-5.5 cyber safeguards. No eval results given.
cyber.quote: Cybersecurity capabilities were found to be at or below the level of GPT-5.5.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: Relies on GPT-5.5's AI Self-Improvement assessment rather than new evals.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: we rely on GPT-5.5's existing Preparedness assessment for AI Self-Improvement, where GPT-5.5 did not meet the threshold for High capability.

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Model trained not to refuse sophisticated biology queries but to refuse weaponization; general safety training inherited from GPT-5.5, no results reported.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: Unlike GPT-5.5, it is trained not to refuse sophisticated biology queries, and leverages a trusted access and responsible deployment structure as the primary safeguard.

system_safeguards.finding: Four-part safeguards: trusted access review, model-level bio/cyber boundaries, monitoring/review/revocation, contractual security controls; no real-time blocking monitors.
system_safeguards.quote: Unlike our safeguards posture for our more broadly distributed flagship models, in this case we are not deploying automated monitors for real-time blocking of potentially unsafe generations.

notable_new_eval_methods: Hard-negative protein binding prediction eval with proposed 50% biorisk threshold (p.7-8)
DNA sequence design for transcription factor binding vs Ledidi baseline, 80% win-rate threshold (p.8)
Beneficial capability evals: Genebench, LifeSciBench, Labwork Bench (p.4-5)

self_reported_limitations.text: Non-biology capabilities and safety not re-evaluated; assumed comparable to GPT-5.5.
Correction to GPT-5.5 protein-binding score (previously reported pass@1 as pass@4).

notes: Specialized domain model; no general-safety, alignment or third-party testing results. Safety framing centers on deployment access controls.
